body:
## Problem
Anonymous users can currently modify other guests and read party records without authentication.

## Agreed scope
Plain HTML/CSS/JS + Firebase; preserve current visual identity. First-run defaults to hosting. All five scores required; drafts local and incomplete votes excluded. Do not implement unrelated open issues #60/#88.

## Implementation plan
1. Add anonymous auth and a shared party-session helper; use authenticated UID as record owner.
2. Model host-created parties and guest membership; admission requires a valid existing invite code. Prevent membership/host impersonation and non-owner writes.
3. Update all Firebase consumers, including trivia/funniest persistence; App Check support must be optional until configured.
4. Document enabling Anonymous Auth, legacy-party migration, coordinated client/rules rollout and rollback. Never deploy production rules automatically.

## Acceptance and verification
- [ ] Emulator denies unauthenticated/nonmember reads and foreign writes/deletes.
- [ ] Host and invited guests can join, read party votes, and write only their own records.
- [ ] Missing/expired party and auth failures show recovery, no infinite wait.
- [ ] Legacy access/migration policy documented and no silent destructive conversion.

## Dependencies and sequencing
Shared contracts first; auth/rules and scoring can proceed independently; sync integrates both; regression suite gates delivery. One coordinated PR may close these issues.

## Risk / rollout / rollback
Auth changes require Anonymous Auth enabled and coordinated rules/client deployment. Emulator verification precedes release. Existing local votes require deliberate migration, never automatic ownership claims over legacy remote identities. Preserve legacy records read-only or export before controlled retirement. Production deployment is outside this implementation; revert the coordinated client/rules release together if rollout fails.
title: Protect party data with anonymous authentication and membership rules

## Implementation plan
1. Replace whole-stage writes with per-act writes; server timestamp and explicit last-server-write-wins policy.
2. Persist pending changes keyed by party/user/contest/act; retry on reconnect; do not erase unrelated remote votes.
3. Show local/pending/shared/offline/error states using accessible live status; actionable retry.
4. Handle listener errors and missing party contexts on all pages.

- [ ] Failed remote writes never display Shared.
- [ ] Reset/leave cannot resurrect votes through stale queued writes.

## Problem

## Agreed scope
Plain HTML/CSS/JS + Firebase; preserve current visual identity. First-run defaults to hosting. All five scores required; drafts local and incomplete votes excluded. Do not implement unrelated open issues #60/#88.

## Implementation plan
1. Require all five integer scores; explicit zero stays valid.
2. Autosave local drafts keyed by party/guest/contest/act; restore after refresh and interruption.
3. Keep hosting first-run default; label Start Party and explain blank invite means hosting; invite links select joining.
4. Add skipped-act recovery and truthful saved-count completion; accessible fieldsets/labels/focus and modal controls.
5. Preserve existing visual style; update help to match actual controls.

## Acceptance and verification
- [ ] Blank/partial submission cannot create a vote; five scores including zero can.
- [ ] Draft score and notes survive reload and remain isolated across party/contest/act.
- [ ] Skip remains available and skipped acts can be rated later.
- [ ] Hosting default explicit; keyboard can complete scoring/settings/dialog flows.

## Problem
Rules permit fractional scores and inconsistent totals; reset removes all remote contests.

## Agreed scope
Plain HTML/CSS/JS + Firebase; preserve current visual identity. First-run defaults to hosting. All five scores required; drafts local and incomplete votes excluded. Do not implement unrelated open issues #60/#88.

## Implementation plan
1. Validate complete integer 0–5 ratings and correct sum server-side; allowlist fields/contest/act IDs.
2. Use the same score contract client-side; preserve missing as null in drafts.
3. Scope reset to selected contest in both local/remote storage; correctly describe shared deletion.
4. Surface deletion failures and protect queued-sync/drafts from restoring deleted records.

## Acceptance and verification
- [ ] Emulator rejects fractional/out-of-range/missing/mismatched-total/unknown-field records.
- [ ] Reset selected contest preserves all other contest records.
